info.name: Buildiq — Icon Endpoints (spec A)
info.description:
Newman integration suite for the buildiq-nextcloud-nav OpenSpec change
(spec A, REQ-OBICON-002 / REQ-OBICON-003). Exercises the two icon-serving
endpoints registered in appinfo/routes.php:

  GET /icons/{slug}.svg       → IconController::iconLight
  GET /icons/{slug}-dark.svg  → IconController::iconDark

Covers spec A task 7.6:
  - GET /icons/hello-world.svg returns 200 + Content-Type: image/svg+xml
  - GET /icons/hello-world-dark.svg returns 200 + Content-Type: image/svg+xml
  - Unauthenticated request returns 401 (or 403)

Presupposes the seeded hello-world Application with attached SVG icons
(SeedHelloWorld repair step, or OR-uploaded attachments).

exec: pm.test('light icon returns 200', function () {
pm.response.to.have.status(200);
pm.test('Content-Type is image/svg+xml', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('image/svg+xml');
pm.test('response body is non-empty SVG', function () {
const text = pm.response.text();
pm.expect(text.length).to.be.greaterThan(0);
// Either a proper SVG or the fallback static file.
// Both are valid -- the endpoint must return SOMETHING.
pm.test('dark icon returns 200', function () {
pm.response.to.have.status(200);
pm.test('Content-Type is image/svg+xml', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('image/svg+xml');
pm.test('response body is non-empty', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.text().length).to.be.greaterThan(0);

item.name: 7.6c — GET /icons/{slug}.svg without auth returns 401
item.description: Icon endpoint is #[NoAdminRequired] but still requires Nextcloud auth. Unauthenticated request must return 401 (or 403 on some NC versions).

exec: // THIS PROBE RETURNED 200 AND WAS READ AS AN AUTHORIZATION HOLE.
// It was not one. `auth: noauth` removes the Authorization header but
// NOT the session cookie Newman already holds for {{base_url}}, so the
// request arrived as the logged-in ADMIN and was correctly served the
// icon. Pointing it at {{noAuthBase}} — the same server under its other
// name, and therefore a different cookie-jar origin — makes it the
// anonymous request this test always claimed to be making.
pm.test('unauthenticated icon request returns 401 or 403', function () {
pm.expect([401, 403], pm.response.code === 200
? 'got 200 — the probe carried a session cookie, so it was NOT anonymous; it must use {{noAuthBase}}'
: 'an anonymous icon request must be refused').to.include(pm.response.code);
